label: deadline-vocabulary-still-seven-final
command:
import t2pw.pipeline.deadline as dl, t2pw.rag.loop_policy as lp, t2pw.pipeline.extraction_ladder as el
print('deadline.TERMINATION_REASONS      n =', len(dl.TERMINATION_REASONS), sorted(dl.TERMINATION_REASONS))
print('deadline.OPERATIONAL              n =', len(dl.OPERATIONAL_TERMINATION_REASONS), sorted(dl.OPERATIONAL_TERMINATION_REASONS))
print('loop_policy.TERMINATION_REASONS   n =', len(lp.TERMINATION_REASONS), sorted(lp.TERMINATION_REASONS))
print('loop_policy MINUS deadline        =', sorted(set(lp.TERMINATION_REASONS) - set(dl.TERMINATION_REASONS)))
print('deadline MINUS loop_policy        =', sorted(set(dl.TERMINATION_REASONS) - set(lp.TERMINATION_REASONS)))
print('SKIP_CAUSES intersect deadline    =', sorted(set(el.SKIP_CAUSES) & set(dl.TERMINATION_REASONS)))
print('round_cap_reached in deadline vocabulary:', lp.ROUND_CAP_REACHED in dl.TERMINATION_REASONS)
try:
    dl.require_reason(lp.ROUND_CAP_REACHED); print('require_reason ACCEPTED it -- UNEXPECTED')
except ValueError as exc:
    print('deadline.require_reason REFUSES it:', type(exc).__name__)
assert len(dl.TERMINATION_REASONS) == len(set(dl.TERMINATION_REASONS)) == 7
assert dl.OPERATIONAL_TERMINATION_REASONS == frozenset({'budget_exhausted', 'operation_timeout'})
assert len(lp.TERMINATION_REASONS) == 8
assert set(lp.TERMINATION_REASONS) - set(dl.TERMINATION_REASONS) == {'round_cap_reached'}
assert set(dl.TERMINATION_REASONS) - set(lp.TERMINATION_REASONS) == set()
assert sorted(set(el.SKIP_CAUSES) & set(dl.TERMINATION_REASONS)) == ['attempt_cap_reached']
print('ALL ASSERTIONS HELD')
